notes.title: 🔨 Smithing Update Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=KMFicDWVWFk;full][/previewyoutube]

* New Features
- Added tin ore vein that generates near water. It can be mined to get tin ore
- Added copper ore vein that generates in deep forest. It can be mined to get copper ore
- All boulders and veins now can be mined dynamically - change the object's shape as you hit it
- Improved game lighting and shadows
- Added wolf that spawns in deep forest. Be careful, it bites!
- Added wolf boss (3rd boss) portal that is currently sealed because the boss is on vacation
- Added clay deposits in deep forest. They can dug with a shovel to get clay
- Added new build Smelter. It can be used to smelt ore into ingots. Mixing copper and tin makes bronze
- Added new item Clay Crucible. It can be used to transport liquid metal (like copper). It can be used to mix together copper and tin to make bronze in ratio 8:2
- Added new item Clay Ingot Mold that can be used to create ingots
- Added simple ingots: copper and tin. These are only placeholders for now because they don't have any use. They also can't be smelted back to liquid yet
- Added complex ingot bronze, which can be hammered into a different shape. It has volumetric properties and can be used on the anvil
- Added Wooden Tongs craft. They can be used to hold any object but are meant to be used with hot ingots
- Added new build Anvil. It can be cast from bronze and allows forging of bronze tools
- Added new tools: Bronze Axe, Dagger, Hammer, Pickaxe, Shovel, and Sword. All tools except the sword are next tier after bone, which means they have better durability and do more damage. The sword can be forged but is only a placeholder for now as it doesn't do damage. This will change in future updates
- Added Quench Tank build. The finished forge can be quenched inside this tank to produce the final tool item
- Added wolf meat, hide, head
- Ores and wood now have max burn value after which they disappear
- Improved world and character upgrade system
- Improved save/load of data. More statuses will be added to the saves in the future

* Bug Fixes
- Fixed bug which prevented placing builds on top of each other

notes.title: v0.2.146 Regular Update
notes.content:
[h1]🆕 New Functionality[/h1]

- Trees have been changed for new models. Tree chopping functionality has been improved. The tree can now also do damage to the player if it drops on top of them
- Auto save added. Default value is 10 minutes. The player can adjust it in the menu book. It can also be turned off or set to a maximum value of 120 minutes
- Equipped armor now saves
- Equipped pocket tools now save
- Can scroll UI with thumbstick and moving and turning is disabled
- Disabled 'Back to Homestead' button when dead in Homestead
- Items now not rolling away from player
- Wiki has been changed and extra controls have been added. Will add more info there in later versions
- The day-night system has been enabled. Each day-night cycle is 60 minutes. You can elapse time with the bed
- The bed build has been enabled and can be now used. When the player clicks on the icon, they can sleep. The time elapses faster and the player wakes up in the morning. The respawn point is also set to the last bed the player has slept on
- Added rabbit, boar and deer sounds effects
- Branches can now be broken into sticks in the sawbuck
- New build has been added - the chest. Save your items in this extra storage. Only backpack items are compatible with the chest. I will add tool and wood racks in later versions
- Rabbits, boars and deers now don't roll away
- When canceling a craft, the craft now resets and the used items are lost
- Sawbuck menu enhanced with available input items
- Sound effects are now pooled which makes them start immediately
- Added sound effect to stick to twigs break

[h1]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed bug where the player couldn't climb stairs
- Fixed bug where the boar head coulnd't be grabbed from a distance
- Fixed bug where sound effect played for boulder destruction when there was none
- Fixed unbuilt floor on load game
- Fixed hands flickering when walking on any build
- Fixed bug where when crafting the stone pickaxe, the stone could be put first
- Saved meat now loads correctly as cooked or burnt
- Distance building bugs have been fixed
- Fixed regular table having 4 extra branch requirements
- Fixed bug where handcraft items could be combined in the backpack
- Fixed bug where the world and player names in the Menu book were empty when going back to Homestead
- Fixed bug where some sticks in the tanning rack build were not transparent on place
- Fixed crafting table tooltip being blank
- Fixed bug where placing dirt moved boulders, trees and builds up
- Fixed bug where stealth eye remained open after boar dies
- Fixed bug where loaded big planks didn't work in the sawbuck
- Fixed bug where objects went through the terrain. An object can still clip if it's moving fast. If it does, you can wait for a bit for it to get teleported to the surface
- Fixed bug where a loaded sapling is 100 times bigger
- Fixed bug where a single item could be used in two separate builds

notes.title: v0.2.145 Regular Update
notes.content:
[h1]🆕 New Functionality[/h1]

- Added icons to Handbook stats
- Added tooltips to stats by suggestion of Lifeinsteps
- Added Handbook and Backpack right hand grabbing poses
- Removed break build binding from primary button on right hand (A on Quest 2). Can now only access from Handbook Builds menu
- Added binding to primary button on left hand to open the Menu book since Valve Index doesn’t have a menu button like Quest 2
- When building, the later parts are now almost invisible to let the player focus on the current order and not try to build later parts (legs of a table before the top)
- By suggestion of ChibiArcher I made the tooltip (the window that shows up when you go over a craft) not clip through the book
- Left hand has been made equal to the right hand. Everything you can do with the right hand, you can now do with the left hand: interact with UI, pick up objects from a distance, build, break build, place dirt.
- Reduced hand grab distance from 20 cm to 15 cm (the near grab not the distance grab)
- Crouch eye now opens when the player is detected by animals and bosses
- Added health bars to animals
- Slight change in the stone dagger model
- Added grab hand poses to all tools
- Added inverted grab to all tools (can grab both ways, rogues rejoice!)
- Consumed food removed floating point from timer and added minutes/seconds
- Added jump sound effect
- Disabled stamina hud by suggestion of JustFrosty
- Disabled distance item placement for crafts
- Arrow craft improved: slide is 60% easier; added indicator; reset craft on cancel; fixed white spots
- Improved performance on standalone devices by a lot (Quest, Quest 2, Quest Pro)
- Changed ocean shader a bit
- Added virtual keyboard. You can now name your characters and worlds the way you want and play the same seed as your friend
- Optimized the Homestead
- Added panting sound effect when under 20% stamina

[h1]🔥 Bug Fixes[/h1]

- Fixed hand offsets
- When let go of object it now correctly goes into the world (it was attached to the backpack before)
- Backpack items now drop on death spot not where you last opened the backpack
- When picking item from backpack if another item is near, it gets picked up too but scale stays the same
- Pocket slots now only store tools and not items
- Improved Handbook, Backpack and pocket slots interaction
- Fixed bug where the player couldn’t put items in the backpack after it was released from the right hand
- Fixed bug where picking items without distance grab caused items to be stuck in the air and move weird
- Fixed a bug where the damage canvas was interactable
- Bone shovel can now dig
- Removed a fun bug where the player could use a shovel to fly around
- Removed loading screen artifacts
- Fixed bug where player’s HP is exactly 0 but player doesn’t die, and consequent errors
